about: Hand tags for src/data/cams.json (Batch SIMPLE-2, Section 6). scripts/build-cams.mjs reads this file with data/coast-cams.json (through src/data/coastCams.ts), src/data/vdotCams.ts and data/cam-sources.json. Untagged cams get the defaults: a beach cam from the coast list is surf + sky with the sea's facing; a VDOT cam is road only with no facing. A VDOT lane label (NB, WB) is never a facing (docs/cams.md, Batch M). How to tag a new cam: docs/cams.md, 'Tagging a cam'. Reviewed 2026-11-19 from VDOT's names and positions and the cam pages' own text; no image was looked at.
